query: How might authorities respond if there's fighting during a work stoppage?
reference_answer:
Violence during Bandhs or Strikes:
Violence during bandhs or strikes can lead to imprisonment up to 3 years and/or a fine, under the IPC Section 307 (attempt to murder) or Section 325 (grievous hurt).
answer: Authorities might impose stricter security measures, enforce a curfew, or call in the National Guard to maintain order if fighting occurs during a work stoppage. [System]
